data.name: PLAYTOWN: Genesis
data.detailed_description:
We are unable to update this game, so in-game logos and credits may be inaccurate and not up to date.

WELCOME TO THE E.Y.E. ORDER

Set in the 1960s, Playtown Genesis places you in the role of Doctor Clint, a newly hired scientist at the Eye Order, a secret underground facility with a dark history. Founded in the 1700s, the Eye Order was established as a sanctuary for sentient eyeballs powered by glowing crystals mined from nearby caves. These eerie beings have used the crystals to fuel their advanced laboratories, maintaining an iron grip over the facility for centuries.

JOIN THE REBELLION

As you begin your work, disturbing events unfold, revealing the Eye Order’s true nature. You discover a hidden rebellion within the facility, led by those who seek to overthrow Hexcor, the ruthless leader of the organization. Drawn into the conflict, you must navigate the terrifying corridors of the order, using stealth and wits to survive as you join the resistance and fight to bring down Hexcor’s oppressive regime.

SURVIVE THE ORDER

In Playtown Genesis, you’ll need to use stealth and clever thinking to move through the eerie corridors of the Eye Order without getting caught by its watchful guards. As Doctor Clint, you'll uncover dark secrets hidden deep within the facility, but trust no one. Every step is risky, and a wrong move could bring Hexcor's brutal enforcers down on you. To stay safe, you'll need to crouch to avoid making noise, sneak past enemies, and work with Garnet, a key ally in the rebellion, on dangerous missions to take down the regime. Outsmart enemies, gather crucial information, and help the resistance bring down the oppressive order from the inside.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 64-Bit or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2500K or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 2 GB or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 4790K or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
